verbatim: The idea is to identify 3 or four pairs of peaks and exclude the central peak.  We may not have to filter out the peaks farther away from the center, since we are looking for the brightest 3 or four pairs of peaks.
interpretation: Prioritize the brightest three or four qualified noncentral conjugate pairs. Upper rejection is optional, not a prerequisite. Preserve side lobes and use inverse evidence to interpret candidates; do not force physical families.
status: Applied during development before any freeze, transfer or helicity comparison.
